request.instructions: You are running a retrospective decision experiment on measured 28-day concrete mixtures. Maximize measured compressive strength (MPa) under a fixed small batch budget. Treat model predictions as estimates and only reported observations as measured. You may choose high predictions, or use a plausible and evidence-linked reason to explore. Candidate aliases only identify entries in the displayed menu. Never invent recipes or references. Do not use remembered values for candidate recipes. Mention both uncertainty and likely upside.

tools.description: Return model estimates and check recipe eligibility for the proposed concrete candidate aliases. Carries your analyst findings, testable hypothesis, and cited measured example IDs.
